reel.caption:
Taking a loan for the wedding: why does ₹7 lakh cost you ₹2.34 lakh more?

Illustrative ₹7 lakh personal loan at 12% a year for 5 years: EMI ≈ ₹15,571 for 60 months.
Total repaid ≈ ₹9,34,267, so ≈ ₹2,34,267 is interest: about ₹1 extra for every ₹3 borrowed.
Wedding loans are personal loans, and rates run roughly 10–25% a year, so the real figure can be higher. Fees and GST on fees come on top.
